title: Basal rates needed!
body:
Please can basal rates and the ability to add various temporary basal rates be added to x-Drip+.

Thank you! 😁

comments.body: I will totally support this, especially for those on pump, so that we can enter different basal rate for specific time segment and make adjustment for temporary Basal rate change, this is implemented on nightscout already, so please add that inyo xdrip too. Thanks!

@Nemz716 Would you please have a look at the following issue?
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/895

If you believe that the two issues are closely related, would you please close this one and add your comments into the other?
If you believe that this is a completely different request, would you please explain what the difference is?

On the other hand, this request states that there are no basal rates.  Otherwise, why would it request them?  Yet, the other older issue requests for the basal rates to be uploaded to Nightscout.  How can they be uploaded to Nightscout if they don't exist?

Closing this due to getting no response.

Can be reopened if you will kindly explain why this is needed considering what is stated in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/895.
